narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding near Brattleboro on July 17. Several roads were damaged.
ev: Flooding caused a culvert to fail and washed out a bridge at Hinesburg Road and Melchen Road in Brattlesboro, VT. A vehicle drove into the washed out section of road and overturned, but there were no injuries. Akley Road was also closed due to flooding.
Multiple roads were damaged due to flooding in West Brattleboro.
